zh-CN.name: video-use 视频剪辑
zh-CN.shortDesc: 基于 Browser Use 的 DesireCore 维护版，支持剪辑、字幕和渲染。默认本地词级转写，首次运行下载固定版本的模型。需要 Python 3.12、uv、ffmpeg 和 ffprobe。可手动选择 ElevenLabs Scribe，需确认所选音轨的上传并自备 API 密钥，服务可能另行收费。

en-US.name: video-use
en-US.shortDesc: Cut, caption and render video with the DesireCore-maintained Browser Use fork. Local word-level transcription is the default and downloads pinned models on first use. Requires Python 3.12, uv, ffmpeg and ffprobe. Optional ElevenLabs Scribe requires explicit selection, upload approval and your own API key. Service charges may apply.
